> 第 17章 巨木氏族（第1页）
“老大，别感伤了，不还有我陪着你吗？放心吧，以我的寿命，一定比你活得更久的！”
就在姜尤感叹之时，在他身旁，一个懒洋洋的男童声传来。
只见一只小乌龟正模仿他的姿态，负爪而立，站在一颗石头上。
小龟装作沉眸环视高山之下，似在俯瞰他的王国。
见他的神态生动，姜尤不由笑骂道。
“小八，不会安慰人就别说话，还活的比我久……”
这小乌龟，可不就活到了第五篇章吗。
他所对应的职业也从二阶的雷霆之翼，进阶成了三阶的“圣翼行者”。
在经历过光明女泰坦之血的洗礼下，他的光明之力的潜力超过了雷霆之力。
二十年内，他将两者超凡之力完美利用，构建在他的职业体系之中。
超凡第三阶，是传奇之下的最强等阶。
到达了这个阶段的人，往往被世人称为英雄！所以也叫做英雄阶位，寿命也得到了延长，能够活五百年！
当然，这是对他们这种普通智慧种族所言，一些天赋异禀的超凡生物，寿命不能以常理计，比如姜尤眼前的小龟。
这可是活到了第五篇章的老古董，体内说不得就有什么不凡的血脉。
或许是姜尤的眼神太过出神，小乌龟不由打了个寒战。
“老大，你这么盯着我干啥，渗得慌！”
姜尤恍然回神，摸了摸它的脑袋，含笑道。
“其实你说的没错，小八啊，多亏了有你。”

就在姜尤和小龟打趣之时，一道充斥了光明之力的带翼身影从天空落下，来到姜尤的面前。
“族长，西方一万里外，有一支巨魔部落往这边来了。”
这可是海滨之地，难道现在的大陆上，已经没有海族的传说了吗？
“罗尔，你叫上天翼小队，跟我去看看！”
天翼小队，便是这二十年来，部落中觉醒了超凡之力的族人，大概有个十几位。
受泰坦之血的影响，他们几乎全是光明之力觉醒者。
不过也由于他们成就超凡，他们的形态进化也远比同族更加惊人。
除了双手双脚没有完全进化之外，他们面部已经全部褪去了羽毛，成为了最接近姜尤的存在。
对罗尔说完，姜尤又对着小乌龟说道。
“小八，你留在族内，防止意外！”
别看小龟可可爱爱，却是实打实的大师阶强者。
“哈哈，小八，我不反对你一起，可是你没有翅膀呀！”
没有翅膀，这个时代也没有法师，唯有传奇才能飞行。
“行了，罗尔你快去叫人，我们马上就出发！”
罗尔带着十几个超凡鹰人出现在姜尤面前。
姜尤一声令下，提着青铜长剑，带着众人往西方而去。
姜尤终于来到了这个巨魔部落的上空。
他往下方看去，只见这是一个大型巨魔部落，足足有一万人。
不过他们的样子看起来十分狼狈，有种被驱逐的感觉。
就在他观察之时，下方的巨魔部落中，响起一道雄浑粗壮的声音。

“天空上，是哪位鹰人王廷的朋友，我们是自然泰坦麾下的“巨木”氏族，还请下来一见！”

> Chapter 17 Jumu Clan (Page 1)
"Boss, don't be sentimental. Don't you still have me with you? Don't worry, with my life span, I will definitely live longer than you!"
Just when Jiang You was sighing, a lazy boy's voice came from beside him.
I saw a little turtle imitating his posture, standing on a stone with its claws behind its back.
The little turtle pretended to look down at the mountains, as if he was overlooking his kingdom.
Seeing his lively expression, Jiang You couldn't help laughing and scolding.
"Xiaoba, if you don't know how to comfort people, don't talk. You'll live longer than me..."
Didn’t this little turtle live until the fifth chapter?
His corresponding profession has also advanced from the second-level Thunder Wings to the third-level "Holy Wing Walker".
After experiencing the baptism of the blood of the Light Titan, the potential of his light power exceeded the power of thunder.
Within twenty years, he made perfect use of the two extraordinary powers and built them into his professional system.
The third level of extraordinary is the strongest level under legend.
People who reach this stage are often called heroes by the world! Therefore, it is also called the hero level, and its life span has also been extended, and it can live for five hundred years!
Of course, this is for an ordinary intelligent race like them. Some extraordinary creatures with extraordinary talents have a lifespan that cannot be measured by common sense, such as the little turtle in front of Jiang You.
This is an old antique who has lived to the fifth chapter, and he must have some extraordinary blood in his body.
Perhaps Jiang You's eyes were too absorbed, and the little turtle couldn't help but shudder.
"Boss, why are you staring at me like this? I'm so scared!"
Jiang You suddenly came to his senses, touched its head and said with a smile.
"Actually, you are right, Xiaoba, thanks to you."
Just as Jiang You and Xiaogui were joking, a winged figure filled with the power of light fell from the sky and came to Jiang You.
"Clan leader, there is a troll tribe coming here ten thousand miles away in the west."
This is a seaside place. Is there no legend of the Sea Clan on the continent now?
"Roel, call the Tianyi team and come with me to take a look!"
The Tianyi Team is the clan members in the tribe who have awakened extraordinary powers in the past twenty years. There are about a dozen of them.
Affected by the blood of the Titans, they are almost all those who have awakened to the power of light.
However, because of their extraordinary achievements, their morphological evolution is far more amazing than that of their peers.
Except for the fact that their hands and feet have not fully evolved, their faces have all lost their feathers, becoming the beings closest to Jiang You.
After speaking to Luo Er, Jiang You said to the little turtle again.
"Xiaoba, you stay in the clan to prevent accidents!"
Although the little turtle may be cute, he is actually a master-level strongman.
"Haha, Xiaoba, I don't object to you coming together, but you don't have wings!"
There are no wings, and there are no mages in this era. Only legends can fly.
"Okay, Roel, go and call someone, we'll leave right away!"
Luo Er appeared in front of Jiang You with a dozen extraordinary hawks.
Jiang You gave the order, held the bronze sword, and led everyone towards the west.
Jiang You finally arrived above the troll tribe.
He looked down and saw that this was a large troll tribe, with a total of ten thousand people.
However, they looked very embarrassed and felt like they were being expelled.
While he was observing, a powerful and thick voice sounded from the troll tribe below.
"Who is the friend of the Yingren Wang Ting in the sky? We are the "Giant Wood" clan under the command of the Natural Titan. Please come down and meet us!"
